hints: Sort values while keeping their original positions.
Fix one value, then use two pointers on the remaining suffix to search for the other two.
Move the left or right pointer according to whether the sum is below or above the target.
analogy: Fix one number and let two ends close in on the needed remainder.
example: For 2,7,5,1 with target 8, sorted values 1,2,5,7 include 1+2+5=8; return their original indices.
algorithm: Sort (value,index) pairs. For each i, run a two-pointer search over j>i and k>j; on equality output the three original indices.
correctness: For each fixed first value, sorted pair sums move monotonically with the pointers, so every candidate pair is either found or safely eliminated.
